Round 324 is a **PASS**, and the browser checks all ran (`browserVerified` = `realVerified` = true). I re-ran every row myself, at 1440×900 and 1280×720 where the row needs a browser, and found no app bug.

**A's STOP.** A stopped over one claim, K19, which needs ≥ 5 and gives 4. The task's own row list makes that impossible. B's spec names five rows, but one of them, `interact.harness.select-same-lane-live`, doesn't match K19's search pattern `"interact\.select`. I checked directly that all five rows are present exactly as specified and that the file only gains lines. I logged this as **C-R324-01 (Low, B's spec)**. Round 323's STOP was different: that tree was unfinished and had a failing test. This tree is complete. If B rules that the literal "≥ 5" is binding, the round becomes a FAIL on that claim alone; no other row changes.

| Row | Result |
|---|---|
| Unit tests | 113/113 files, 1714/1714 tests; perf report tests 34/34 |
| Mutants | All 6 turn their rows red. My own memo-removal mutant for the group header, which stayed green last round, now fails its new test (SS8a) |
| PERF-SELECT | Components per selection click: 107 on HEAD → 25 on A. Re-clicking a selected clip: 92 → 0 components (one empty commit). No harness failures |
| Other perf rows | 27 rows rose slightly (+2 or +3 components per edit). The extra renders all come from the new selection subscribers, at most once per name per commit, which the task allows |
| PERF-LOAD | 164 rows identical, none rose |
| Render-name probes | HEAD re-renders 10 unrelated components on a selection click; A re-renders none. The mutant that puts selection back in the shared context brings all 10 back |
| Browser behaviour vs HEAD | Click, edit, detail panel, transport and range behaviour: all 52 recorded states identical. Video add: no in-between frame where the range is gone but the old selection still shows (HEAD has 2) |
| Export | The four project WAVs (HEAD and A, both viewports) are byte-identical: 304.056 s, 48 kHz, 24-bit stereo |
| Folded-group selection (S-GROUP, redefined) | Ctrl+A while folded selects 3 of 3 blocks and the group stays folded; screenshots are byte-identical to HEAD |
| Premium sign-in | Not bypassed. A fresh session with no login opens the demo; the paid Studio page asks for sign-in; the token API refuses (401 / 500 / 400) |

On a PASS these close: C-R322-01, C-R322-02, C-R323-01, C-R323-02 and INFO-C323-S-GROUP-PREMISE. The Ableton comparison doesn't apply, because this round is a performance change with no change in behaviour.

**For B:**
- Rule on K19: either accept 4, or change the pattern. `grep -cE '"id": "interact\.(select|harness\.select)'` gives 5 on this tree and 0 on HEAD.
- Record that ruling as a decision entry even if root publishes first.
- Folding a group still clears the clip selection on both trees. That was already known, and it stays a question for the regression round.

I didn't run the full test suite, build, Biome, typecheck, `npm run verify` or the e2e smoke; those are the gate's job. The store is unchanged (42 status entries before and after), and my extra dev servers are stopped.
